decks.notes: The main goal of this deck is to take advantage of the interaction between Emry, Lurker of the Loch, Underworld Breach, and Mishra's Bauble to set up combos that can mill the opponent out or win the game with Thassa's Oracle. The deck uses cards like Grinding Station and Malevolent Rumble to further enable these combo plays, while also utilizing Urza's Saga and Mox Amber for additional synergy and ramp. The inclusion of Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student and Spell Snare helps control the board and protect the combo pieces while setting up for a powerful win condition.

The main concept of this deck is to control the game by ramping up mana with Eldrazi Temple and Urza's Saga while using powerful Eldrazi creatures and equipment like Walking Ballista and Blade of the Bloodchief to dominate the battlefield. The deck aims to maintain board presence with cards like Glaring Fleshraker and Delighted Halfling while disrupting the opponent's strategy with spells like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble. The inclusion of cards like Basking Broodscale and Ancient Stirrings ensures consistency and flexibility in executing the game plan. The deck's ultimate goal is to overwhelm the opponent with sheer power and control.

This deck focuses on aggressive gameplay using a diverse mana base to cast powerful creatures and spells quickly. Utilizing companions for additional resources and focusing on a mix of red, green, and white cards, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a combination of efficient creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Territorial Kavu, supported by removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Fatal Push. The key strategy is to maintain pressure on the opponent through early aggression and efficient card choices, ultimately leading to a swift victory.

The deck focuses on playing without using lands and relies heavily on combo pieces to win the game. Cards like Goblin Charbelcher and Hydroelectric Specimen are essential to the strategy, along with a mix of counterspells like Pact of Negation and Suppression Ray to disrupt opponents. Using cards like Whir of Invention and Tameshi, Reality Architect, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful spells. The goal is to win the game through a combination of clever plays and efficient use of resources.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creatures and efficient removal spells to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds another powerful threat to the deck. With a mix of creatures like Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, along with burn spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge, this deck aims to maintain board presence and deal damage quickly. The inclusion of Static Prison helps to control the opponent's board while the overall strategy revolves around pushing through damage and securing a quick victory.

This deck aims to assemble a combo involving Underworld Breach, Grinding Station, and Emry, Lurker of the Loch to mill your opponent's entire library and win the game with Thassa's Oracle or Malevolent Rumble. Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides card draw and filtering, while Mox Amber and Mishra's Bauble help with mana acceleration and card advantage. The deck includes disruption through cards like Unholy Heat and Spell Snare, as well as Urza's Saga to tutor for key pieces. The goal is to efficiently combo off and win the game quickly before your opponent can react.

This aggro Jeskai deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a variety of efficient creatures and burn spells. Utilizing Jegantha as a companion allows for additional mana ramp, while cards like Goblin Bombardment and Lightning Bolt provide direct damage to finish off opponents. The One Ring and Static Prison help control the board, while powerful creatures like Phlage and Guide of Souls provide a solid late-game presence. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah offers additional control options, making this deck a versatile and aggressive force to be reckoned with in Modern 1 vs 1 format.

This deck focuses on a landless combo strategy, utilizing cards like Fallaji Archaeologist, Goblin Charbelcher, and Lotus Bloom to quickly assemble a win condition. The deck also includes control elements like Jwari Disruption, Pact of Negation, and Suppression Ray to protect the combo. Additionally, cards like Thundertrap Trainer and Tameshi, Reality Architect help to manipulate the opponent's board state. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to quickly set up a powerful combo without relying on traditional land drops, while controlling the game and disrupting the opponent's strategy.

The main concept of this Mono Black Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's hand and board through discard spells like Inquisition of Kozilek and Thoughtseize, along with removal spells like Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes powerful creatures like Dauthi Voidwalker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to control the board. Soul Spike and Necrodominance provide additional removal and reach, while creatures like Orcish Bowmasters and Boggart Trawler help stabilize the board. The deck's win condition is to outvalue the opponent with card advantage and efficient removal spells, while utilizing powerful finishers like Fell the Profane and The One Ring.

This Boros Aggro deck focuses on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay using powerful creatures like Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury and Amped Raptor to quickly overwhelm the opponent. The deck also utilizes disruptive cards like Blood Moon and Static Prison to control the board and prevent the opponent from stabilizing. Ajani, Nacatl Pariah and Goblin Bombardment provide additional versatility and reach, while Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer provides card advantage. With consistent mana fixing and a versatile sideboard option in Jegantha, the Wellspring, this deck aims to win the game quickly and efficiently.

This Mardu Aggro deck focuses on quickly overwhelming the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures like Amped Raptor and Guide of Souls, and powerful spells like Thoughtseize and Orcish Bowmasters. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds extra utility and flexibility to the deck. The deck also includes strong removal spells like Static Prison and Galvanic Discharge to control the board. With a mix of creatures, spells, and lands that support its aggressive strategy, this deck aims to build a strong board presence and quickly close out games.

This deck focuses on utilizing a combination of spells and creatures to quickly generate mana and disrupt the opponent's strategy while aiming to win the game through the use of Goblin Charbelcher. The key strategy involves setting up a fast win condition by assembling the necessary components to cast Charbelcher, while controlling the game with counter spells and disruptive cards. The deck aims to create a high-pressure situation for the opponent and force them to react, ultimately leading to a quick victory through the activation of Goblin Charbelcher.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly using Eldrazi Temple and Utopia Sprawl to cast powerful Eldrazi creatures like Emrakul and Kozilek. It also utilizes control elements like Kozilek's Command and Malevolent Rumble to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The inclusion of Sowing Mycospawn and Devourer of Destiny provides additional card advantage and board presence. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with massive threats while maintaining control over the game with a mix of ramp, disruption, and powerful creatures.

The main focus of this deck is to efficiently use disruptive countermagic and spell manipulation in order to assemble the Goblin Charbelcher combo. By using cards like Disrupting Shoal, Pact of Negation, and Commandeer to protect key pieces while stalling the opponent, the deck aims to quickly assemble the Charbelcher combo for a devastating one-hit kill. Additionally, the deck includes various control elements such as Suppression Ray and Sink into Stupor to slow down the opponent's game plan, giving the pilot time to set up and execute their winning combo.

The main concept of this Boros Aggro deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a combination of fast creatures like Amped Raptor and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer, while also using powerful spells like Lightning Bolt and Galvanic Discharge to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Ocelot Pride and Phlage, Titan of Fire's Fury add additional reach and damage potential, making it a fast-paced aggressive deck that looks to close out games quickly. The companion Jegantha, the Wellspring adds an additional layer of consistency and versatility to the deck.

The main idea of this deck is to ramp quickly into powerful Eldrazi creatures such as Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Emrakul, the Promised End using cards like Utopia Sprawl and The One Ring, while controlling the board with spells like Kozilek's Command and All Is Dust. The deck also includes ways to cheat these big creatures into play early with cards like Through the Breach. Additionally, there are some utility lands like Boseiju, Who Shelters All to protect your important spells and creatures. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large threats and powerful control elements.
